tools.name: search_parts
tools.description: Searches EasyCircuit's electronics parts catalog by name, function or role (for example 'OLED display', 'temperature sensor', 'ESP32 board'). Returns matching parts with their catalog ids, interfaces, pin roles, and whether each can be ordered in a kit.

tools.name: get_part
tools.description: Returns one catalog part by its catalog id, including its pin evidence and electrical capabilities.

tools.name: get_part_pins
tools.description: Returns the pinout of an exact part: each pin's function, voltage, direction and polarity, with the source of each fact and any conflicting sources. Long pinouts are paged; next_offset is the offset of the next page.

tools.name: get_part_capabilities
tools.description: Returns the electrical capabilities of an exact part: pin roles, drive type, voltage ranges, required terminals, protocols, and whether each fact is physically verified.

tools.name: catalog_summary
tools.description: Counts catalog parts by status and role.

tools.name: check_design
tools.description: Runs EasyCircuit's wiring checks on a complete circuit design without saving it. Returns status (passed or blocked), blockingIssues that prevent saving, designWarnings from general electrical rules (such as a part with no ground pin) that do not apply to every part, and reviewWarnings for pin facts

tools.name: save_design
tools.description: Saves a circuit design that has no blocking wiring issues and returns a link that opens it in the EasyCircuit editor, with schematic, breadboard and perfboard views, editing, and parts ordering. Anyone with the link can open a copy. Designs with blocking issues are not saved.
